onePageSummary: ‘Journey of a River’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects river source and flow, tributaries, landscapes along a river, people depending on rivers, floods and pollution. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
quickChecks: Define or explain river source and flow.
Define or explain landscapes along a river.
Define or explain people depending on rivers.
Define or explain floods and pollution.
Define or explain change from source to mouth.
Define or explain observation and evidence.
Define or explain cause and consequence.
examStrategy: Read the situation, identify the relevant idea, support the answer with evidence or working, and check before submitting.
